title: Verify check returns 404 'was not found' when the code was already approved or has expired
symptoms: HTTP 404 from verificationChecks.create with a valid Service SID
A second check of the same code fails after the first one succeeded
Checks fail when the user enters the code after 10 minutes
cause: Twilio deletes a verification once it is approved, expires after 10 minutes, or reaches the maximum check attempts, so any later check finds nothing.
fix: Treat a 404 from a check as used or expired, and start a new verification. Do not check twice on retry.
